description: Sealed pushes (docs/m4-design.md section 5, D126, D127): h = "1." keyId (16 lower-case hex) "." base64url(nonce (12) ‖ ChaCha20-Poly1305(key, nonce, aad, padded)), base64url as RFC 4648 section 5 without padding, always 1,763 characters; aad = the ASCII bytes hsn-push/1, a zero byte and the 8-byte key id; padded = the UTF-8 JSON of PushContent, the byte 0x80, then zero bytes up to 1,280 bytes (content at most 1,279 bytes). `seal`: sealing `contentJson` with `key`, `keyId` and `nonce` must give exactly `aad`, `padded`, `sealed` (nonce, ciphertext, 16-byte tag) and `h`; opening `h` with `key` held under `keyId` must give `content`. `contentJson` is the exact bytes sealed; `content` is the same as an object. `open`: the opener holds `key` under `keyId` and no other key; opening `h` must be refused with `expect`, checked in this order: badFormat (anything but 1, a dot, 16 lower-case hex digits, a dot and 1,744 base64url characters: another version, a truncated or oversized h, whitespace, upper-case hex, + / or =); unknownKey (no key held for h's key id); decryptFailed (the tag does not verify: a wrong key, any changed byte, other associated data); badPadding (the last byte that is not zero is not 0x80, or there is none); badContent (the bytes before that last 0x80 are not UTF-8 JSON of a PushContent). A PushContent is an object with exactly these fields, and no others at any level: v 1; hub, 26 characters of a-z and 2-7; n, an object of seq (an integer 0 to 2^53 − 1), atMs (an integer 0 to 2^53 − 1), clockOk (a boolean), kind (1 to 64 characters), category (one of sensorSilentWhileDisarmed, sirenPathLost, gatewayOffline, batteryLow, armDisarm, updates, countdown, alarm, localAlarm, tamper, longPress, sensorSilentWhileArmed, sirenSilent, jamming, scheduleMissedOrHeldBack, disk, newClient, backup, hub, stateUnexpected), critical (a boolean), device (null or an integer 1 to 2^32 − 1) and cause (null or an integer 0 to 2^53 − 1); delayed, a boolean; names, an object with any of device, person, client, mode and schedule, each 1 to 64 characters; detail, optional, an object whose keys are 1 to 64 characters and whose values are strings, finite numbers or booleans; actions, an array of none or one of disarm and armAway; armed, a boolean. Lengths of text are counted in Unicode code points, not UTF-16 units or bytes: 🚪 (U+1F6AA) is one, a letter and its combining accent two. The relay's two alerts are contents of kind hub_unreachable and hub_back, category hub, n.seq 0, n.atMs 0, n.clockOk false, not critical: the phone decides their loudness from the home's last armed state it saw (D96) and takes their time from their arrival.
